source_type: World Bank report
key_finding: 811m estimated extreme poverty in 2026; jobs and earnings highlighted
limitations: 2025-26 figures are nowcasts; macro-level not an intervention evaluation

source_type: UNDP statistical report
key_finding: 1.2bn of 6.3bn in 108 covered countries experience multidimensional poverty
limitations: Coverage excludes some countries; dimension definitions differ from monetary measures

source_type: Systematic review (35 studies, 93 interventions)
key_finding: Behavioural interventions evaluated; results heterogeneous
limitations: No meta-analysis owing to heterogeneity; transferability limited

source_type: Meta-analysis (51 studies, 187 effects)
key_finding: Applications easier to increase than completed benefit receipt
limitations: Do not substitute application rate for actual take-up

source_type: IEA descriptive policy review
key_finding: Over 120 energy affordability policies introduced in 2025 tracked
limitations: Policy count does not prove causal effect; strongly local context

source_type: World Bank institutional synthesis
key_finding: Economic inclusion programmes described as reaching ~70m people in 2024 with reports of improvements
limitations: Coverage is not equivalent to causal impact for each participant; older data

source_type: 3ie methods and maps
key_finding: EGMs catalogue impact evaluations and reviews and illuminate evidence gaps
limitations: An evidence map does not in itself recommend policy

source_type: Randomised field experiment; peer-reviewed QJE
key_finding: SNAP enrolment after nine months: control 6%; information 11%; information plus application assistance 18%
limitations: Eligible-or-likely-eligible older adults; targeting and net-welfare implications, not portable intervention effects

source_type: Experimental weatherization evaluation; peer-reviewed QJE
key_finding: In this programme, actual energy savings did not cover upfront investments; project costs around twice realized energy savings
limitations: Cannot generalise to all retrofits or contexts; private energy savings and model predictions differ; other outcomes not established here

geography: Ethiopia; Ghana; Honduras; India; Pakistan; Peru
source_type: Six randomized controlled trials; Science
key_finding: Graduation package improved consumption in five of six study contexts, with follow-up after implementation ended
limitations: Integrated, relatively intensive programme; component contributions not separately identified; contextual effects, costs, and transferability vary

source_type: RCT; Giannella et al., Administrative Burden and Procedural Denials
key_finding: Approvals +6 percentage points; long-term participation over +2pp
limitations: 65k applicants; single agency; procedural context

source_type: two nationwide experiments; Castell et al., Take-up of Social Benefits
key_finding: In-person assistance +29% relative take-up; online simulator no significant effect
limitations: Jobseeker sample; attendance selection and French institutions

source_type: six pre-registered RCTs; Linos et al., Can Nudges Increase Take-Up of the EITC?
key_finding: No detectable change in filing or claiming despite one million observations
limitations: Low-touch nudges; non-filers; not a test of intensive assistance

source_type: cluster RCT; Domenella et al., Non-take-up: in-person and digital outreach
key_finding: Applications rose; no robust increase in approvals
limitations: 400 census tracts; follow-up burden; eligibility uncertainty

source_type: four field experiments; Interventions to bolster benefits take-up: outreach framing
key_finding: Light-touch outreach +0.14 to 2 percentage points take-up in targeted settings
limitations: COVID-era child tax credit/stimulus; modest absolute effects; external validity

source_type: systematic-review-meta-analysis; Martin et al., ACA marketplace enrollment interventions
key_finding: Mean +0.9 percentage points; support-based larger than information-only
limitations: Health insurance enrollment; mix of 32 RCTs and 2 quasi studies; overlapping component trials

source_type: field experiments; De La Rosa et al., Psychological ownership government benefits
key_finding: Interest in claiming benefits increased under ownership framing
limitations: Interest and navigation not evidence of verified receipt; mechanism context

source_type: systematic-review; McAndrew et al., Household energy efficiency interventions
key_finding: Review finds heterogeneous effects; combined strategies often more successful
limitations: Variable outcomes and study quality; not all low-income households

source_type: systematic-review; Systematic Review of Energy Efficiency Home Retrofit Evaluation Studies
key_finding: Average savings roughly 7.2%; no programme reached 50% savings in included sample
limitations: Overlapping programmes; mixed designs; bill savings not equal to wellbeing

source_type: systematic-review; Financial support and fuel poverty health outcomes
key_finding: Many studies report improved warmth or wellbeing, but large design heterogeneity
limitations: Predominantly nonrandomised studies; causal strength varies; cost uncertainty

source_type: nonrandomized-comparison; Energy coaching and fix-team retrofitting
key_finding: Fix teams associated with improved perceived comfort and financial concerns
limitations: Self-selection; nonrandom groups; survey outcomes; short follow-up

source_type: quasi-experiment; EJUSTA energy counselling quasi-experimental evaluation
key_finding: Local counselling assessed; causal effects and full estimates require full-text extraction
limitations: Convenience comparison group; selection bias; do not extrapolate

source_type: RCT; Non-price conservation information and consumption RCT
key_finding: Expert conservation advice reduced electricity use and bills in trial
limitations: Affordability vs suppressed consumption and welfare not established

source_type: regression-discontinuity; Impact evaluation of the social electricity tariff
key_finding: Near cutoff spending lower by R$15.35 monthly and consumption lower by 20kWh
limitations: Local discontinuity and possible underconsumption; cannot claim improved comfort

source_type: difference-in-differences; Bagnoli and Bertomeu-Sanchez, social electricity rate
key_finding: Small reduction in energy-poverty probability; lower bills without higher use
limitations: Parallel-trends and household eligibility assumptions need full text

source_type: longitudinal-observational; Searle et al., Structural improvements and energy poverty
key_finding: Structural measures and financial help associated with better outcomes; small advice mixed
limitations: Not randomised; self reports; attribution confounded by policy and site

source_type: cluster RCT; Howden-Chapman et al., Insulating houses and health inequality
key_finding: Bedroom warmth +0.5°C and lower energy use in intervention households
limitations: Multi-outcome trial; original health and utilisation endpoints need fuller extraction

source_type: RCT; Howden-Chapman et al., Improved heating for children with asthma
key_finding: Reduced symptoms and school absence; lung function change nonsignificant
limitations: Health-targeted households; not direct proof of lower energy bills

source_type: RCT; Blattman et al., Generating skilled self-employment
key_finding: At year four earnings +38%; business assets +57%
limitations: Young applicants in post-conflict region; same trial as later E? follow-up

source_type: RCT-longitudinal-followup; Blattman et al., Nine-year youth grants follow-up
key_finding: Earlier earnings gain faded; treated and controls converged
limitations: NOT an independent trial from 2014; long-run attrition and context

source_type: RCT; Alfonsi et al., Tackling youth unemployment
key_finding: Both improved jobs; vocational training effects arose more slowly and lasted longer
limitations: Urban youth and firm selection; training intensity and cost

source_type: field experiment; Blattman et al., Returns to microenterprise support
key_finding: At 16 months microenterprise ownership and incomes roughly doubled
limitations: War-affected women; heterogeneous effects; package not unbundled

source_type: six-year field experiment; Bandiera et al., Search for Good Jobs
key_finding: Vocational training raised outcomes; additional matching sometimes worsened search and job quality
limitations: Same cohort interventions within single experiment; employer selection

source_type: RCT; Blattman and Dercon, Industrial and entrepreneurial work
key_finding: Factory offers no durable earnings gain and increased health risks; business package earnings +33%
limitations: Five firms; attrition and local factory conditions

source_type: RCT; Can a light-touch graduation model enhance livelihood outcomes?
key_finding: Some livestock/asset gains; no detectable consumption improvement
limitations: May not cross poverty trap; targeted population and programme dose

source_type: RCT; Bandiera et al., Labor Markets and Poverty in Village Economies
key_finding: Increases in earnings and asset accumulation sustained at years four and seven
limitations: Strong programme-support context; nonparticipants and markets matter

source_type: field experiment; Brown et al., Financial incentives for apprenticeship trainers
key_finding: Apprentice earnings +24% and skills +0.15SD two years later
limitations: Trainer incentive trial; does not identify effects of apprenticeship access itself

source_type: critical-evidence-review; McKenzie, Active labor market policy critical review
key_finding: Many programmes have small or no significant gains
limitations: Narrative review; overlapping with later review; varies by policy

source_type: research-synthesis; Carranza and McKenzie, Job Training and Job Search Assistance
key_finding: Typical impacts often small; context and cost-effectiveness critical
limitations: Review overlaps McKenzie 2017 and individual trials
